collection.title: Alpina B10 1997 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Alpina B10 Saloon 1997 to 2004 requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 26" for the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Latch arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
